status: post-review exploratory extension, not external preregistration
already_inspected: 2021–2025 and earlier January–June 2026 analyses; 2025 is not a fresh independent test
inner_validation: last six months before each outer test year
target: observed next hourly-bin NO2 at horizons 1, 3, 6, 24 hours
purge: target timestamp precedes each split boundary; no crossing training targets
hyperparameter_selection: minimum inner validation RMSE within each feature/imputer/algorithm combination

missingness_benchmark.masking: per-channel contiguous blocks before lag construction; future observed targets never imputed
missingness_benchmark.baseline: last available NO2 for synthetic sensor outage, not hidden clean current NO2

negative_results: reported without retrospectively changing the outer selection
source_claims: units reported from explicit source headers, unresolved physical identities are not guessed
